findings: THE ANSWER IS NO. The best of 25 graded cells reads 0.361394823 of the free-tile stroke at the 90th percentile under C-0087's measured dropout - uniform at 1000 pN/nm on 26 ties at phase 23 - against T-5b's 0.10 and against the best array cell's 0.597884179 on the same real stations. Exceedance 1.0000.

THE CENSUS MOVES THE COUNT AND THE PHASE MOVES WITH IT. C-0093's ceiling of 53 upward sites is C-0063's phase 24; over all 32 phases the largest inventory is 60, at 10 of them (0,1,2,14,15,16,17,18,30,31). And the same 8 bp plane lattice carries the sheet's own crossover columns: C-0015's eight-column phases are 6,7,8,9,10,22,23,24,25,26, DISJOINT from the richest ones, and C-0063's two centro-symmetric phases (8 and 24) are not richest either. The lattice offers the coupling its most stations exactly where it offers the SHEET its fewest crossovers.

THE CHEAP DIVISION SAID SO BEFORE THE SEARCH RAN. C-0093's own redundancy fit, refitted here from its density table at a slope of -0.784357442, predicts 0.3083 of the stroke at 60 ties - so the placement and the distribution axes together had to be worth 3.08x. C-0089 measured a distribution at 1.30-1.61x on an array and C-0074's irregular-beats-regular at 1.13x, whose product is 1.82x. The search measured 0.99x from the distribution and 1.95x from the phase.

F2 did NOT fire, AND THE DISTRIBUTION AXIS IS A CASUALTY OF THE VERY DIVISION THAT MAKES THIS TOPOLOGY FLATTER. At a stiff tie a rigid shared body pins its stations onto a PLANE - a kinematic constraint that does not depend on the tie distribution at all - so the whole distribution family collapses onto one design: over five very different tie shapes at 1000 pN/nm the 90th percentile spreads by 0.0018 and the zero-defect dishing by 0.0724. C-0089's 1.30-1.61x exists because an ARRAY divides C-0017's mandate between its stations and a distribution redistributes a scarce budget; a shared body puts the mandate in its GROUND, and that is the same sentence twice.

AND THE DESCENT OVERFITS, WHICH IS THE SAME BOUND SEEN FROM THE OTHER SIDE. On its own 6-realisation training ensemble the descent reads 0.5241/0.4168 against the uniform start's 0.6705/0.5584 - an in-sample gain - and on C-0087's independent 40 realisations it reads 0.6052/0.4197 against 0.5446/0.4149. Where there is nothing left to win, a 53-parameter percentile descent chases the training sample's noise: C-0089's 1.30-1.61x on an array was a real gain because the array's mandate is scarce, and the same machinery on a near-kinematic coupling is worth 0.99x.

THE TIE LADDER IS ALREADY AT ITS OWN CEILING. The uniform 90th percentile runs 0.3780 -> 0.3330 -> 0.3040 -> 0.3010 -> 0.3006 -> 0.3006 over ties of 3/10/100/1000/10000/100000 pN/nm, and the matrix departure from the kinematic limit falls as 1/s (2.11e-02 -> 7.79e-03 -> 8.19e-04 -> 8.24e-05 -> 8.24e-06 -> 8.24e-07) - so no stiffer tie and no redistribution of stiffness is available, and the force allowable is not what stops it either: the peak tie force under dropout runs 3.60 -> 4.22 -> 5.43 -> 5.63 -> 5.65 -> 5.65 pN against C-0006's 10 pN unzip.

AND THE COUNT ARGUMENT SURVIVES ON THE REAL LATTICE, MEASURED ON IT RATHER THAN EXTRAPOLATED ONTO IT. Fitted over 6 placement-searched counts on the real upward sites the redundancy slope is -0.221299799 against C-0093's -0.784357442 on the abstract grids, and it crosses T-5b's 0.10 at 22823.1 ties against the 60 the lattice owns - 380.39x short. C-0089's run-length arithmetic says the same thing with no solve at all: it demands 13 attachment columns in a row and the upward line's bare 32 bp pitch offers 4 at every phase.

THE TOPOLOGY'S OWN NUMBERS REPRODUCE AND THE PLACEMENT IS WORTH SOMETHING REAL. C-0063's 34 roots read 0.0706145537 (array) and 0.0344013403 (rigid shared body) at zero defects and 0.597884179 / 0.457563267 at the 90th percentile; the full real inventory at the best phase reads 0.414873006 at 53 uniform ties, i.e. 1.10x better than the shared body on C-0063's own stations. The placement axis is the one that paid.

5 of 5 buildability rows do not clear: upward crossover sites the body may be tied at, best phase; attachment columns C-0089's run-length demand asks of one row; phases that are BOTH richest in upward sites and eight-column hosts; phases that are BOTH richest and centro-symmetric; does §3 describe a two-layer tile?.
